steps.note: K1a.1 has rows 0-1 subtracting the old scratch contributions and rows 6-7 restoring them, and K1a.2 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values a,c, as at 744-750.
K1a.3 gives the bit central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling intersection one, zero and two already zero, self coefficient one, matching 752-755.
K1a.4 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling distinct triples with intersection zero or two, intersection one zero, self one, matching 756-758.
K1a.6 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with every auxiliary wire restored, as at 761-764.
The plan asserts that edges join comparable labels (K1c.4) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions from the table at 1022-1043.
K1c.1 notes neighboring triple lines are orthogonal, but the side edge 2->5, the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y-perp and the complement <t_X,t_Y>-perp of dimension h-2 never appear.

K1c.4 gives the only decreasing edges as center 3->4 losing h, K1c.2 and K1c.5 give sources N, sinks Wm-N, the telescoped signed total Wm-2N and the extra 2L for absolute changes, as at 1061-1071 (and 891-894).

K1c.6 shows each nonzero residual contains a norm-one vector, hence nonalternating, and K1c.7 applies the fact that nondegenerate nonalternating binary spaces have orthonormal bases, matching 1073-1102; the plane-absorption proof itself is not spelled out.
K1.d states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly as at 1105-1109.
T2a.0 defines q_U(x)=wt(P_U x) mod 4 and uses weight additivity mod 4 over orthogonal vectors so each residual basis vector contributes its own phase term, a faithful paraphrase of 1232-1245.

T2a.0 states each norm-one v has odd weight, the phase is i^{+-[v.x]} = (1+i^{+-1})/2+(1-i^{+-1})/2(-1)^{v.x}, and under the H-tensor-m-conjugated frame this is a kernel aI+bX_v; the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X is used only implicitly through that frame form.

T2a.2 gives one kernel per residual basis vector and T2a.6 (quoting 1905) gives exactly s_c child calls, one per unit of residual dimension, each acting on all f columns of a slot, which is the column-tensored factor count of 1262-1271.

T2a.0b only asserts the telescoping to C^{tensor m} after unspecified corrections; the zero/full label frames I and C^{tensor m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} repair and the negated X outputs are not stated (T2a.1's C^{-1}=-iZCZ is quoted from 1827 in another role).
K1.d gives both ratios below 1/2, and K1V1.3/K1V2.2 derive the positive deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c and hence s<Wm, as at 1105-1110 and 1167/1260.
K1V3's method names the relative deficit eta_b but never gives its value 339/22587335000000.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 appears nowhere in the plan, which names eta_c only in K1V3's method.
K1V3.1-K1V3.3 state both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50}, log m<20 from m<2^20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, as at 1331-1343.
K2 only quotes the lemma statement A=E_1 Pi E_2 (line 1366); the elimination proof with the topmost-row rightmost-entry pivot and lower-triangular clearing is not given.
K3 works over Z/q^bZ but never states the choice of a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator of the finite factor table so that the triangular factors stay invertible.
K3.1 states a lower triangular transformation of H or D costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, with inverses again lower triangular, as at 1425-1430.
K3.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j with only the middle step an interchange, and K3.4 counts a interchanges, as at 1432-1443.

E=64(W+m+1)^3 (T2d.3), B=s+E (T2d.5), Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) (T2d) and C_1=20 (PC.1) appear, but C_0=128mB^2, the definition of nu and C_1=max{20,nu+3} (with nu=11) are never stated, so the constant block is only partly given; marked absent under the when-unsure rule.
T2d.2-T2d.4 give the per-invocation count 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E and the recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at internal nodes, A(e)<=8e at leaves, as at 2479-2518.

T2d.8 states depth-l values lie in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and T2d.9 gives Delta=o(p) from epsilon C_1<1, as at 2562-2586.
T2.3 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}, as at 2751-2757.

summary: 18 of 26 present, 8 absent, none wrong. Fully covered: bank-exchange-network (4/4), the simultaneous-layer recurrence, unrolling, guard bits and contraction (S2-S5), and the matrix-shear cost steps (M3, M4). Missing: the residual table and the side edge 2->5 (L1, L2), the endpoint repair in the phase interface (P4), the explicit eta values (R2, R3), the elimination proof and the choice of prime (M1, M2), and the full constant block of the guard-width bound (S1: C_0, nu and the C_1 formula are never defined).
